newsitem.title: ROMANIA: AirTouch to bid for Romania GSM licence.
newsitem.headline: AirTouch to bid for Romania GSM licence.

text.p: AirTouch Communications Inc of United States and Canada's Telesystem International Wireless have formed a consortium to bid for a GSM licence offered by Romania in a tender next week, the consortium said.
Romania's private Logic Telecom SA, the state-run Posta Romana post authority and ISAF engineering firm are also part of the group, the new MobiFon consortium said in a statement on Wednesday.
MobiFon raises to four the number of consortia officially to announce their participation in the tender.
On Tuesday, Telefonica de Espana SA, said it planned to sue the Romanian government in a bid to block the tender for two GSM licenses scheduled for September 26.
Telefonica said its Romanian branch had been promised the right to a digital mobile telephone service when it started an analogue service in Bucharest in 1992.
But Romania's communications ministry dismissed Telefonica's claims on Wednesday, saying they were groundless and that it would go ahead with plans for the tender next week.
The tender requires companies to be able to cover at least 65 percent of Romania with the GSM system, to have solid operating experience and financial strength to back the costs of the project.

Implementing the licences is expected to cost some $1.0 billion. The telecoms ministry says the potential market for digital mobile phones is huge in Romania, with a population of 23 million people and relatively few landlines. Romania is the last country in the region to set up a digital GSM system. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
